dialogs.about: 영어 수업에서 선생님께 다시 말해달라 부탁

lines.en: Please repeat after me. How are you today?
lines.ko: 저를 따라 하세요. 오늘 기분이 어때요?

lines.en: Teacher, can you say that again, please?
lines.ko: 선생님, 다시 한 번 말해 주시겠어요?

lines.en: Sure. Listen. How are you today?
lines.ko: 그럼요. 들어 보세요. 오늘 기분이 어때요?

lines.en: I'm fine, thank you. What does 'today' mean?
It means this day. Now ask me a question.
lines.ko: 오늘이라는 뜻이에요. 이제 저에게 질문해 보세요.

lines.en: Did you speak English when you were young?
Yes, I learned it when I was ten.
Great. I will speak more at home.
Good. Tell your family about the lesson.
lines.ko: 좋아요. 가족에게 수업 이야기를 해 주세요.

lines.en: I will. I will explain every word to them.
lines.ko: 그럴게요. 모든 단어를 가족에게 설명할 거예요.

lines.en: Hello, it's Mom. Can you hear me?
Yes, Mom. Why did you call?
I want to tell you some good news.
What is it? Please say it slowly.
Your father finished his English class yesterday.
Really? Did he answer well in class yesterday?
Yes. He answered every question yesterday.
That's great! Tell him I'm proud.
I will. Will you call him tomorrow?
Yes, I will call again tomorrow. Thanks, Mom.
lines.ko: 네, 내일 다시 전화할게요. 엄마, 고마워요.
